gaps.explanation: Statement debt_proceeds 3,285,000 (p6) = bond issuances Airport 685,000 + Streets 2,600,000. detail[] holds Airport 'Bond issuances' 685,000 (B-4 p20) + Streets 'Bond issuance' 2,600,000 (C-1 p22) = 3,285,000, which ties exactly, plus Streets 'Bond premium' 36,608 (C-1 p22), which the gap check counts as debt proceeds. The statement JSON records that same printed bond premium 36,608 under other_financing (sale of capital assets 751 + insurance and settlement recoveries 41,812 + bond premiums 36,608 = 79,171, p6), not in debt_proceeds. 3,321,608 - 36,608 = 3,285,000. The premium line is printed and correct; it is only classified as other financing on the statement side, so nothing is added or removed.
